event_text: An unknown party has access to Staples Canada's staplesprint.ca website
Staples emails affected customers about the security incident
notes: Les Affaires says the message went out Friday evening.

event_text: Global News publishes the first report of the notice
CBC News publishes its report, with a statement from a Staples spokesperson
The Canadian Press reports that a Staples spokesperson says no other Staples website was affected
notes: Winnipeg Free Press posting time; the wire says it was first published Nov 20.
